alt: Rooftop dinner table above Kuta beach, Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

activities.name: Central Bali in a vintage Volkswagen
activities.match: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul
activities.description: A day out in an open top vintage Volkswagen taking in the Bali swing, Tegenungan waterfall, the spring temple at Tirta Empul and the rice terraces.

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot
activities.description: The Handara gate, the lake temple of Ulun Danu Beratan and a hill waterfall, finishing at the sea temple of Tanah Lot for sunset.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Three nights in a valley villa at Sayan, with a vintage car day through central Bali and a full day up to the Bedugul lakes.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Uluwatu and Nusa Penida
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Garden hotel in Seminyak, ten minutes from the beach

activities.name: Melasti beach, water sports and Uluwatu
activities.description: The white sand at Melasti beach, banana boat and jet ski at Tanjung Benoa, then Uluwatu temple and the Kecak fire dance at sunset.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west with Paluang cliff
activities.description: Speedboat across for the Paluang cliff viewpoint, Kelingking beach and the rock arch at Angel's Billabong, with Broken Bay after it.

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: An hour of traditional Balinese massage for both of you on your free day, warm oil and long pressure strokes at a spa in Kuta.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the coast with a south Bali beach day, a full island day on Nusa Penida and a rooftop candlelight dinner to finish.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your valley villa at Sayan
First evening free above the Ayung river
Optional: the Monkey Forest or the Ubud art market
2: Breakfast, then a day out in an open top vintage Volkswagen
The Bali swing and Tegenungan waterfall
Tirta Empul, the holy spring temple
The Tegalalang rice terraces on the way back
3: Breakfast, then a full day north to the lake country
The Handara gate and Ulun Danu Beratan temple
A hill waterfall in the afternoon
Sunset at Tanah Lot, the sea temple on the rocks
4: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer to the coast
Melasti beach, white sand below the cliffs
Banana boat and jet ski at Tanjung Benoa
Uluwatu temple and the Kecak fire dance at sunset
5: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
The Paluang cliff, Kelingking beach and Angel's Billabong
Return boat to Bali and back to your hotel
6: Breakfast and a free day on the coast
An hour of Balinese massage for two at a nearby spa
Rooftop candlelight dinner for two in the evening
Optional: a late walk along the beach afterwards
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: The rooftop dinner is included, not an upsell. It is the last evening, five floors above the beach, and it lands well.
expert.tip: Book the massage for late afternoon on the dinner day so you walk up to the roof relaxed. Sunset is around half past six all year, and we hold the best table for seven.

summary: Seven days for two with three nights in a valley villa at Sayan and three on the coast, taking in a vintage car day through central Bali, the Bedugul lakes, Melasti beach, Uluwatu, Nusa Penida and a rooftop candlelight dinner.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; central Bali tour in a vintage Volkswagen; full day Bedugul tour with Tanah Lot; Melasti beach with water sports, Uluwatu and the Kecak dance; Nusa Penida west coast tour; Balinese massage for two; rooftop candlelight dinner.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and other dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
